'''R4-D12 '''was an [[R4 astromech droid|R4]] [[astromech droid]] owned by the professional [[racer]] [[Marcus Speedstar]]. The [[droid]] assisted Speedstar in navigating [[Galaxy's Glory|his ship]] during races. In [[34 ABY]], the astromech took part in the [[Platform Classic]], a major race held on the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[Fuel|refueling]] station on [[Castilon]] that was ultimately won by Speedstar.

==Biography==
[[File:GalaxysGlory-CGSWG.png|thumb|300px|left|R4-D12 in the droid socket of ''Galaxy's Glory'']]
During the [[New Republic era]], R4-D12 and the [[Esral'sa'Nikto]] [[Oplock]] were members of the racing champion [[Marcus Speedstar]]'s team. The [[droid]] and Oplock accompanied Speedstar when they visited his estranged older brother [[Jarek Yeager]] aboard the ''[[Colossus]]''. While Yeager's [[Team Fireball|Team ''Fireball'']] were friendly to the visitors, Yeager refused to speak with Speedstar, whom he blamed for the [[death]]s of [[Jarek Yeager's wife|his wife]] and [[Jarek Yeager's daughter|daughter]].<ref name="The Platform Classic" />

During the [[Platform Classic]], R4-D12 sat in the [[astromech socket]] of Speedstar's [[Racing starfighter|racer]] ''[[Galaxy's Glory]]''. Yeager taunted Speedstar by claiming that D12 looked worried. Speedstar responded by making fun of Yeager's [[astromech droid]] [[R1-J5|Bucket]]. During the race, Yeager complimented D12's loyalty to Speedstar. During the race, Yeager reconciled with his brother after realizing that Speedstar wanted to save Oplock, who had been taken hostage by the [[Guavian Death Gang]] for unpaid debts. Yeager allowed Speedstar to win.<ref name="The Platform Classic" />

==Characteristics==
R4-D12 was an [[R4 astromech droid]] who assisted Marcus Speedstar in navigating his racer ''Galaxy's Glory'' during races.<ref name="R4-D12 DB">{{Databank|r4-d12|R4-D12}}</ref> He was deeply loyal to Speedstar.<ref name="The Platform Classic" />

==Behind the scenes==
R4-D12 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|Season One]] episode "[[The Platform Classic]]" on [[November 25]], [[2018]].
